culture.text: A large listed company of about 15,107 people, working in fragrance and beauty and in taste and wellbeing.
Staff often have chemistry, chemical engineering, business, marketing or economics backgrounds, with main jobs in operations, research and sales.
Top schools are international, including ISIPCA, University of Buenos Aires and Universidade de Sao Paulo.

growth.text: Plans a new USD 215 million production plant in Indiana, USA.
Founded in 1895 and headquartered in Vernier, Switzerland.
